About India Paperwork Guide

An independent, open-access public resource simplifying Indian government paperwork, statutory fees, and official procedures for everyday citizens.

Important: Independent Information Website

This website is an independent informational resource. It is not an official government website and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, authorized by, or connected to any government agency, ministry, or department. All procedures, documents, fees, and requirements are compiled for informational purposes and verified against official government portals.

We never charge citizens for access, we do not ask for login credentials or payment details, and we do not act as agents or touts. Official applications must always be submitted directly on official portals ending in .gov.in or .nic.in.

Our Civic Mission

Every year, hundreds of millions of Indian citizens visit government offices—Regional Transport Offices (RTO), Passport Seva Kendras (PSK), Tehsildar offices, and municipal corporations—only to be turned away because they were missing a single photocopy, brought the wrong address proof, or were unaware of the official statutory fee.

This information vacuum allows touts and unlicensed middlemen to overcharge citizens by 5x to 10x the statutory government fees.

India Paperwork Guide was created to solve this problem. Our goal is simple: Know exactly what documents, photos, forms, and fees you need before you step foot in any government office or apply online.

✓

100% Verified Sources

Every fee amount, rule reference, and document requirement is cited directly from official Gazette notifications, the Motor Vehicles Act, Passport Rules, or official .gov.in circulars.

₹

Statutory Fee Transparency

We clearly separate statutory government fees from optional courier or SMS charges, warning citizens against paying commission or bribes to unauthorized intermediaries.

📖

Class 8 Reading Level

Complex legal regulations are translated into plain, actionable language that any first-time applicant can easily follow without confusion.

★

State Specific Personalization

Indian public services differ across states. We personalize procedures, portal links, and regional requirements per state, with Gujarat as our launch focus.

How We Verify Information

Read our strict 4-step verification protocol, 90-day review cycles, and how we audit every single government link and fee.

Editorial Independence & Funding

To keep this service 100% free for all Indian citizens without paywalls or mandatory sign-ins, India Paperwork Guide is supported by privacy-respecting online advertising.

Our Editorial Promise: Advertisers and sponsors have zero influence over our checklists, requirements, fees, or procedural guidance. We do not accept paid placements from visa agents, driving schools, or legal brokers. Every official link points strictly to authenticated government portals.

Our Team & Contributors

We are an independent group of civic technologists, public policy researchers, and open data enthusiasts based across India. We believe that public paperwork should be accessible, transparent, and dignity-affirming for every citizen.
